themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Multiple right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying their focus on anti-immigration policies in response to recent border crises. This theme is particularly prominent in Spain, Italy, and Norway, where parties like Vox, Lega, and Fremskrittspartiet are advocating for stricter border controls and criticizing government responses to migration surges.

themes.title: Far-right parties gain ground in regional and national elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are making significant electoral gains across Europe, particularly in Germany and Sweden. The Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) is leading in polls for upcoming state elections in Saxony-Anhalt, while Sverigedemokraterna continues to shape Swedish politics. This trend reflects growing support for far-right platforms across the continent.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties and governments are proposing significant reforms to social welfare programs, citing fiscal concerns. In the UK, Reform UK has unveiled plans to overhaul the welfare system, while in Argentina, Javier Milei's government is implementing austerity measures. Similar debates are occurring in Norway and Poland about the sustainability of social benefits.

themes.title: Trump administration targets gender-affirming care and LGBTQ+ rights
themes.blurb: The Trump administration in the United States is implementing policies that restrict gender-affirming care and LGBTQ+ rights. These policies are finding echoes in other countries, particularly Poland and the UK, where right-wing parties are proposing or implementing similar restrictions. The trend reflects a broader conservative pushback against progressive social policies.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders face internal party divisions and leadership challenges
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across multiple countries are experiencing significant internal divisions and leadership challenges. In Italy, the Lega party is facing calls for Matteo Salvini to step down. In Poland, Prawo i Sprawiedliwość is dealing with factional splits. Similar challenges are occurring in Spain with Vox and in Argentina with La Libertad Avanza.
